'''Hildan's Storehouses''' were a set of two buildings, divided into ten warehouses that were located in [[The Puddle]]. They were decrepit and two of them were damaged beyond usage. The warehouses were occasionally rented out by smugglers or local merchants.<ref name="H&S" />
